record.edic_text:
696 arguros {ar'-goo-ros}

from argos (shining);; n m

AV - silver 5; 5

1) silver
   1a) 1 Cor. 3:12 refers to the silver with which the columns of
       noble buildings were covered and the rafters adorned
   1b) things made of silver
       1b1) vessels
       1b2) images of gods
